screen.subject: BJT模擬テストのお知らせ

lines.en: Hello, and welcome to Kamaru Business Japanese.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Today is lesson 5: 25 words — BJT test words.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: First, let's listen to a notice sent round the company.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Subject: Notice of a BJT mock test
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: To: All employees
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: HR is announcing a BJT mock test.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Whether your Japanese gets across accurately in real business situations is very important for your work.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: So, as a chance to measure your Japanese objectively, we will hold a mock test in-house next month. Anyone who wishes can take it.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The test has three parts: listening, listening-and-reading, and reading.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: In listening, you hear audio and choose an answer from the options shown on screen.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: In reading, there are also questions where you judge from context and choose the words that go in a blank.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: All answers are made on a computer. The results show not only correct and incorrect answers but also which areas are weak.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: You can choose between two test dates depending on your work schedule.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Recently there have been more reports of inappropriate expressions when dealing with customers. Please also use this as a chance to review your keigo.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Recognizing your own level of Japanese accurately is the first step to improving.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Needless to say, the results will not affect your performance evaluation.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Applications are well up on last time, so please apply early.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Human Resources
lines.name: ナレーター
